desc:
🎤 Rap battle against your friends or enemies to gain wins and climb the charts. Collect unique skins, throw tomatoes, and become the best rapper Roblox has ever seen...

Features in Epic Rap Battles
🏆 Level up by playing matches & voting!
🔊 VC only servers for the real pros!
🪙 Earn coins to purchase microphone skins!
🔥 Tons of unique beats you can use to dominate your competition

Leave a like 👍 and a favorite ⭐ if you enjoy our game!

Disclaimer: Please do not share real life information (address, real name, location), or try to bypass the Roblox filter.

Join the LavaFlow Studios group to get a special Fire Microphone skin! 🎤
Inspired by Auto Rap Battles
